integrity: The counting kernel uses multiplicities, with unnormalized Walsh characters. Finite checker run is not a proof for all n; all-size proof uses forest enumeration and p-adic valuation comparison. Classical exact cyclic-set distribution credited to Pitman.
scientific_limitations: Only odd prime powers n=p^a (p>=3), and only the p-primary Smith spectrum. General n, other local primes, real spectral gaps and full integral Smith form are not settled.
title: The \(p\)-primary Fourier and Smith spectra of cyclic sets in random mappings
